title: 50 Seconds: The Fernando Báez Sosa Case
overview: This documentary series explores the case of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.

title: A Friend, a Murderer
overview: A Danish town feared a serial criminal for eight years. When caught, Amanda, Nichlas and Kiri discovered the perpetrator was their close friend who'd committed assaults, kidnappings and murder while spending time with them.

title: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
overview: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

title: American Conspiracy: The Octopus Murders
overview: An investigative journalist pursuing a political conspiracy known as the Octopus is found dead in his hotel room. Decades later, new details emerge.

title: Angi: Fake Life, True Crime
overview: Sentenced for the murder and impersonation of her friend, this documentary sheds new light on Angi — and the death of her husband years before.

title: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
overview: In this eye-opening documentary exposé, teens and parents reveal disturbing accounts of abuse and exploitation within the world of child influencers.

title: Bad Surgeon: Love Under the Knife
overview: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini is world famous for his revolutionary stem cell-infused windpipe transplants. There's just one problem: His patients keep dying.

title: Bad Vegan: Fame. Fraud. Fugitives.
overview: After marrying a mysterious man who claimed he could make her dog immortal, a celebrated vegan restaurateur finds her life veering off the rails.

title: Beauty and the Bester
overview: Did renowned Dr Nandipha get embroiled in Thabo Bester's prison break? This chilling documentary series examines the enigmatic ties that bound them.

title: Cocaine Cowboys: The Kings of Miami
overview: Two childhood friends go from high school dropouts to the most powerful drug kingpins in Miami in this true story of a crime sage that spanned decades.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes
overview: Mixing present-day interviews with previously unheard recordings, this true-crime series examines serial killer David Berkowitz's mark on 1970s New York.

title: Crime Scene: The Texas Killing Fields
overview: An overgrown field and a stretch of highway connect a series of grisly murders spanning several decades as grieving families search for answers.

title: Crime Scene: The Vanishing at the Cecil Hotel
overview: The notorious Cecil Hotel grows in infamy when guest Elisa Lam vanishes. A dive into crime's darkest places.

title: Pervert: Hunting the Strip Search Caller
overview: This docuseries follows the investigation into a hoax caller who talked managers into strip-searching employees at fast food businesses across the US.

title: Dope
overview: Filmed from the perspectives of dealers, users and the police, this vivid series offers a bracing look at the war on drugs.

title: Drug Lords
overview: Witness the stories of history's most notorious kingpins, their terrifying enforcers, and the men and women who've sworn to bring them down.

title: Evil Genius
overview: This baffling true crime story starts with the grisly death of a pizza man who robs a bank with a bomb around his neck - and gets weirder from there.

title: Fear City: New York vs The Mafia
overview: New York City in the 1970s was ruled with a bloody fist by five mafia families, until a group of federal agents tried the unthinkable: taking them down.

title: I Am a Stalker
overview: Convicted stalkers and survivors share harrowing accounts of harassment, abuse and other crimes in this documentary series.

title: I Just Killed My Dad
overview: Anthony Templet shot his father and never denied it. But why he did it is a complex question with profound implications. Explore Anthony's psyche prior to the events of June 3, 2019 and the journey of his mental and emotional aftermath.

title: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
overview: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

title: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez
overview: Via interviews with friends, players and insiders, this docuseries examines how Aaron Hernandez went from an NFL star to a convicted killer.

title: Love Con Revenge
overview: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.

title: Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street
overview: This docuseries follows the rise and fall of financier Bernie Madoff, who orchestrated one of the biggest Ponzi schemes in Wall Street history.

title: My Lover My Killer
overview: British true crime documentary series telling the real life stories of those who paid the ultimate price for offending an obsessive lover.

title: The 43
overview: This docuseries disputes the Mexican government's account of how and why 43 students from Ayotzinapa Rural Teachers' College vanished in Iguala in 2014.

title: The Christine Jessop Story
overview: On Oct. 3, 1984, Christine Jessop went missing in Queensville, Ont. Three months later her body was found, and it would be another 35 years until the mystery was finally solved. Over three, hour-long episodes, for the first time ever, Christine’s family speaks shares their story including a desperate search for answers, a falsely accused suspect, corrupt policing, revolutionary forensics, and a family forced to go through the unthinkable.

title: The Devil Next Door
overview: A Cleveland grandfather is brought to trial in Israel, accused of being the infamous Nazi death camp guard known as Ivan the Terrible.

title: The Diamond Heist
overview: This stranger-than-fiction crime caper follows the attempted robbery of a precious gem, told by the gangsters who did it and the police on their tail.

title: The Pharmacist
overview: After his son's tragic death, a Louisiana pharmacist goes to extremes to expose the rampant corruption behind the opioid addiction crisis.

title: The Ripper
overview: For five years, from 1975 to 1980, the Yorkshire Ripper murders cast a dark shadow over the lives of women in the North of England. 13 women were dead and the police seemed incapable of catching the killer. No one felt safe – and every man was a suspect.

title: The Sons of Sam: A Descent into Darkness
overview: The Son of Sam case grew into a lifelong obsession for journalist Maury Terry, who became convinced that the murders were linked to a Satanic cult.

title: The TikTok Killer
overview: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

title: The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt
overview: This docuseries digs into the disappearance of 13-year-old Yara and the disconcerting investigation that shattered the peace of a small Italian town.

title: This Is a Robbery: The World's Biggest Art Heist
overview: In 1990, two men dressed as cops con their way into a Boston museum and steal a fortune in art. Take a deep dive into this daring and notorious crime.

title: Till Murder Do Us Part: Soering vs. Haysom
overview: Did Jens Soering murder his girlfriend's parents in 1985 — or was she the killer? This docuseries digs into questions that still swirl around the case.

title: Trial 4
overview: Charged as a teen in the 1993 killing of a Boston cop, Sean K. Ellis fights to prove his innocence while exposing police corruption and systemic racism.

title: Unabomber: In His Own Words
overview: Anchored by a rare interview, this docuseries details Ted Kaczynski's path from a young intellectual to one of the most feared people in US history.

title: Waco: American Apocalypse
overview: This docuseries includes never-before-seen material from the infamous 51-day standoff between federal agents and a heavily armed religious group in 1993.

title: When Missing Turns to Murder
overview: British true crime documentary series using powerful and emotional testimony from families and friends when a missing persons enquiry turns into a murder investigation.

title: World's Most Wanted
overview: Heinous criminals have avoided capture despite massive rewards and global investigations. This docuseries profiles some of the world’s most wanted.
